verdict.rationale: Pendo's own Data Sync feature exports Pendo data to third-party storage destinations: Snowflake with no engineering, plus S3, Azure and Google Cloud. That is a first-party way to move event data out of the platform, but it is a warehouse or cloud-storage export, not shown as event streaming to activation tools. The integrations page claim is generic and names no outbound event-forwarding destinations. Missing for 10: real-time event streaming, outbound forwarding to CRMs and ad platforms, registrable outbound webhooks, and independent corroboration.
